//.no-descending-specificity: disabled globally — high false-positive rule whose specificity comparison ignores @media / interactive-state context, so hover rules re-declared at lower specificity inside the 760px mobile block flag as 'descending' even though they never conflict. Only ~3 of ~8 fires are order-fixable (a @media block must follow the base rules), and the rule has no per-selector ignore. Every other config-standard rule stays enabled.
//.media-feature-range-notation: pinned to 'prefix' (config-standard defaults to 'context') — the range form '(width <= 760px)' needs Safari 16.4, but the app's real floor is Safari 16.2 (gallery color-mix). Keep the '(max-width: 760px)' form.
//.unit-ban: declaration-property-unit-disallowed-list forbids vh/svh/lvh on every block-axis sizing property (physical height* AND logical *block-size) — this is the exact viewport-collapse bug Part A fixed; only dvh is allowed for full-viewport height.
//.canonical-override: crates/aozora/assets/*.css ships raw to the VS Code extension / afm and never passes through autoprefixer, so its hand-written -webkit-* fallbacks must survive. The vendor-prefix rules are the ONLY carve-out for it; all formatting rules still apply (single quality bar). NOTE: overrides.files globs are resolved relative to THIS config's directory, so the pattern is '../crates/...' (a tail-anchored '**/...' would anchor under playground/ and never match a file outside it).
//.webkit-scrollbar: the two ::-webkit-scrollbar selectors in styles.css carry inline `stylelint-disable-line selector-no-vendor-prefix` — no standard equivalent exists and autoprefixer never rewrites selectors.
